subject: BrightBridge: verification packet request - onboarding / background / training artifacts
messages:
From: Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@brightbridge.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
Cc: security-assess@brightbridge.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding/background/training evidence for SOC2 readiness assessment

Hi Jonas,

Hope you're well — I'm Claire on the BrightBridge security assessment team. As part of our SIG/SOC2 pre-assessment for BrightBridge's procurement team, we need to review Redwood's controls around personnel onboarding, background checks, training, and offboarding. Can you provide the following artifacts for review by EOD Tue (2026-09-01)?

Requested items (redact PII as needed):
- Background-check matrix (status + verification date) for hires in the last 12 months
- Training completion exports for security awareness and data handling (CSV preferred)
- Standard onboarding checklist and role-based access request templates
- Offboarding/access revocation log showing user/service account deprovisioning for last 12 months
- HR attestation letter confirming background-check policy and training cadence

Also useful: mapping from employee IDs to account usernames (hashed or redacted) so we can reconcile controls to accounts. If you have a single consolidated package (Drive link or ZIP), please share it.

Thanks — if the timeline is tight let me know and we can extend one business day.

Best,
Claire Hughes
Security Assessor, BrightBridge Capital
(attachment: brightbridge-evidence-request-20260830.pdf)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
To: Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@brightbridge.com>
Cc: laura_bennett, maya_srinivasan
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding/background/training evidence for SOC2 readiness assessment

Claire — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Laura (HR) and Maya (Security ops) to gather the artifacts.

Quick clarifications so we deliver exactly what you need:
- Date range: do you want the last 12 months relative to today (Aug 2025 - Aug 2026) or a fixed window (e.g., Jul 2025 - Jul 2026)?
- For the background matrix, is a per-hire row with a unique, non-PII identifier acceptable (we will redact names and SSNs)?
- For access revocations, do you need service accounts included or only human user accounts?

We'll prepare a redacted packet and provide a Drive link + a signed HR attestation via DocuSign. ETA: we can upload the package by end of day Monday (2026-08-31) if that works.

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
(attachment: none)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com; Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@brightbridge.com>
Cc: maya_srinivasan@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding/background/training evidence for SOC2 readiness assessment

Claire / Jonas — Laura here (People Ops). We've pulled the primary artifacts and are preparing a redacted export. Summary of included files:

- redacted-bg-checks.csv (columns: hire_id, hire_date, check_type, check_status, verification_date) — PII removed, hire_id is an internal hashed id
- training-completions-2025-2026.csv (columns: hire_id, course_id, completion_date, certificate_id)
- onboarding-checklist-templates.pdf (company standard checklist + role templates)
- offboarding-access-revocations-2025.csv (columns: account_id, hire_id, revocation_date, revoked_by)
- hr-attestation-signed.pdf (signed attestation of policies and frequency)

Notes / limitations:
- We will not provide raw SSNs or birth dates; all personally identifying fields are redacted per our privacy policy.
- Service-account revocations are included in a separate sheet; let us know if you want them combined.

I'll upload the packet to a shared Drive folder and grant BrightBridge access. If you need a CSV with mappings to hashed usernames for account reconciliation, indicate the hashing format and we can provide that under an NDA addendum.

Attaching a short checklist of the fields we've redacted for your review.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
People Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redacted-bg-checks.csv; training-completions-2025-2026.csv; onboarding-checklist-templates.pdf; offboarding-access-revocations-2025.csv; hr-attestation-signed.pdf)

From: Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@brightbridge.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com; jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
Cc: security-assess@brightbridge.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding/background/training evidence for SOC2 readiness assessment

Thanks Laura — this looks aligned with what we usually need. A couple of follow-ups:

- Date range: Jul 1, 2025 -> Jul 31, 2026 is preferable for our sampling; can you confirm the exports cover that window?
- The hashed hire_id is fine. For reconciliation, can you include the hash-salt method (e.g., SHA256 with x salt) or a short attestation that the mapping is irreversible?
- Please include the policy doc name and effective date for background-checks and training cadence in the packet (we usually see the policy PDF + an attestation).

If you can upload the Drive package and send permissions to claire.hughes@brightbridge.com and security-assess@brightbridge.com, we'll begin our review. If anything needs to be redacted further for privacy/regulatory reasons, please flag it and we'll note it in our report.

Claire
